## Overview

Script 4 generates all integration visualisations from the ATAC-seq and
RNA-seq integration files produced by Script 2. For each pairwise
comparison it produces heatmaps, scatter plots, volcano plots, distance
histograms, pairwise Venn diagrams, GO/KEGG enrichment bar charts, and
protein interaction network plots. Two 3-way Venn diagrams are produced
after the main loop showing gene overlap across all Group 1 and Group 2
comparisons simultaneously. The AM133 versus AMAll comparison had no
overlapping genes and is skipped gracefully throughout.

All plots of the same type are directly comparable across comparisons —
achieved by fixing colour scales, axis limits, and network size scales
globally before any individual plot is generated.

## Methods summary

### Heatmap

One row per gene — the most significant ATAC-seq peak selected per gene
(lowest padj, absolute log2FC as tiebreaker). Rows ordered by concordance
category then by descending absolute ATAC-seq log2FC. Fixed diverging
colour scales set to the 95th percentile of absolute fold change values
across all comparisons — ensures the same colour represents the same fold
change magnitude in all heatmaps.

### Venn diagrams

Unique gene counts used — each gene counted once regardless of peak count.
Pairwise Venns show ATAC-seq genes versus RNA-seq genes per comparison.
3-way Venns show overlap across all three comparisons within each
biological group.

### GO/KEGG enrichment

Gene symbols converted to Entrez IDs using bitr. enrichGO run for BP,
MF, and CC ontologies. enrichKEGG run for KEGG pathways. All terms
retrieved with no internal p-value cutoff, then filtered to p-value
≤ 0.05 and count ≥ 2 before plotting. Two versions per comparison:
whole genome background and custom background (all genes near significant
ATAC-seq peaks across all comparisons, padj ≤ 0.05).

### Protein interaction networks

STRING database version 11.5, Gallus gallus (species 9031), medium
confidence threshold (score ≥ 400). Hub score = normalised degree
(degree / global maximum degree across all networks). Fixed node size
and colour scales across all networks — same legend applies to all.
Fruchterman-Reingold force-directed layout.

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
